title: Resort Style 6BR Heated Pool + Mini Golf Sleeps 18
description:
***Luxury 6BR Retreat | Heated Pool & Mini Putt | Sleeps 18***

Newly renovated 6-bedroom, 3-bath home (12 beds) with beautiful finishes, and an inviting backyard. heated resort-style pool and mini putting green—perfect for families, groups, and extended stays.

Located in a quiet neighborhood, minutes from Chandler Fashion Center, Tempe (ASU), and Old Town Scottsdale, this home offers the ideal blend of relaxation and convenience.

 The space 
• 3,100+ sq ft of living space
• 6 bedrooms | 3 bathrooms | Sleeps 18
• Two spacious living areas with large TVs
• Fully stocked kitchen with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances & Keurig
• Full laundry room with brand-new XL washer & dryer
• Family-friendly: High chair & Pack ’n Play

🌴 Outdoor Living

• Private Heated* pool (optional daily fee)
• Mini putting green
• Gas firepit & outdoor seating
• New WEBER BBQ grill
• Newly updated landscaping

🛏️ Sleeping Layout (Main Level)

• Queen suite
• Bedroom with two full beds
• Full bathroom with walk-in shower

(Upper Level)

• Primary suite: King bed + trundle (2 twins), luxury ensuite bath
• Second king bedroom
• Queen suite
• Bedroom with twin bunk beds
• Two additional full bathrooms

✨ Extras (Optional)

• Pool heating available for $50/day. Advance notice required; temp set to 83–85°F. Heating applies to the entire stay. Ask about flat rates for longer stays

- Concierge services available: Pre-stocked groceries, housekeeping, décor, restaurant reservations & specialty packages (fees vary)

📍 Prime Location

• 5 minutes to Chandler Fashion Center, dining & groceries
• Close to golf courses, hiking & family attractions
• Easy access to AZ-101 freeway
• Approximately 20 minutes to Sky Harbor Airport

📌 Good to Know

- Weekly pool & landscaping service (brief backyard access required)
- Discounts available for weekly & monthly stays
- For stays over 28 days, bi-weekly cleaning is required

📋 House Rules (Important)

• No smoking of any kind in the home
• No parties or events
• Quiet hours after 9 PM
• Registered guests only (extra guest fees apply)
• Pet-friendly for cats & dogs with a $50/pet fee (no pets on furniture, beds, or in the pool).

🏠 Guest Access

• Guests enjoy exclusive access to the entire home, private garage, driveway, and backyard.

____________________________

Traveling with a larger group or need multiple homes?

We have additional luxury properties, including:
• 6, 7-bedroom / 3-bath with heated pool
• 5-bedroom / 3-bath with pool & spa

Please message us for availability or monthly discounts.

 Guest access 
Entire home and garage are yours to use.

 Other things to note 
Short-Term Rental Registration Number: Chandler License #308194, State TPT #21564961

This property is fully licensed and compliant with local short-term rental regulations.
